definitions.explanation: The positive outcome or fruit of one's efforts or work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{成果|せいか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{成果|せいか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}する→発表：03562_happyou⟧。
examples.english: To present the results of the research.

examples.japanese: {成果|せいか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: We were able to achieve results.

notes:
USAGE:
Usually refers to positive achievements or outcomes:
・{成果|せいか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to produce results)
・{成果|せいか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ (to achieve results)
・{成果|せいか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (results appear)
・{成果|せいか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{収|おさ}める→収める：02022_osameru⟧ (to achieve success)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧{成果|せいか} (research findings)
・⟦{学習|がくしゅう}→学習：02623_gakushuu⟧{成果|せいか} (learning outcomes)
・{成果|せいか}⟦{主義|しゅぎ}→主義：03215_shugi⟧ (results-oriented approach, performance-based)
・⟦{成果物|せいかぶつ}→成果物：17168_seikabutsu⟧ (deliverable, output)

NOTE:
{成果|せいか} implies successful or productive results. For neutral or negative results, use ⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧ - result (neutral)
・⟦{実績|じっせき}→実績：04214_jisseki⟧ - track record, achievements
・⟦{業績|ぎょうせき}→業績：04873_gyouseki⟧ - performance, accomplishments
